name: Activity Feed
description: Chronological list of actor-plus-action events with avatars or icons and timestamps, optionally grouped under day headings.
usage:
<ActivityFeed
  label="Project activity"
  groupByDay
  items={[
    { id: "1", actor: "Ada Lovelace", action: "merged the parser rewrite", timestamp: new Date() },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: A role="feed" region with an accessible label describing whose activity it lists.
One focusable article per event; its accessible name combines actor, action, and time, with aria-posinset and aria-setsize for position.
An initials avatar per actor, or a status icon when events are typed.
Optional Today/Yesterday groupings when groupByDay is set.

dos: Supply items newest first; the feed renders them in the order given.
Keep the action text to a short phrase so articles stay scannable.
Turn on groupByDay for feeds spanning several days.
donts: Don't use it for machine logs; use LogViewer.
Don't nest interactive controls inside events; the feed pattern expects focus on the articles themselves.

examples.title: Flat feed
examples.description: Shows events newest-first with initials avatars and relative-looking timestamps.

examples.title: Grouped by day with icons
examples.description: Groups events under Today/Yesterday headings and swaps avatars for status icons per event type.

guidance.useWhen: A project, document, or account page needs a readable history of who did what and when.
guidance.avoidWhen: Events are machine logs rather than human activity; use LogViewer instead.
guidance.behavior: Renders items in the order given (supply newest first), formats timestamps via formatTime, and groups by calendar day when groupByDay is set.
guidance.responsive: Stacks avatar, text, and timestamp vertically in a single column that wraps at narrow widths.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the feed articles.
Moves focus to the next or previous article in the feed.

notes: Uses the ARIA feed pattern: the container has role feed and each event is a focusable article with an accessible name combining actor, action, and time.
Each article exposes aria-posinset and aria-setsize so screen readers announce its position in the feed.

props.description: Message shown when there are no items.
props.name: emptyMessage

props.description: Formats the day heading when `groupByDay` is on; defaults to Today/Yesterday/weekday labels.
props.name: formatDay

props.description: Groups items under a heading per day.
props.name: groupByDay
